latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Local speech-to-text for 小宇宙 podcasts using Qwen3-ASR

- Transcribe 小宇宙 (Xiaoyuzhou) podcast episodes to text locally with Qwen3-ASR (Metal/CUDA accelerated).
- Integrates xyz API to fetch episode metadata and audio URLs.
- Supports keyword search, single/batch episode download, and batch transcription.
- Provides full workflow: search, download, split audio, transcribe, and format output as markdown.
- Requires local xyz API server, ffmpeg for audio processing, and a built-from-source qwen3-asr-rs binary.
- Enforces audio segment length limits (≤3 minutes) for GPU stability; all data is processed locally, ensuring privacy.
